📱✨ Make A Phone Case! ✨📱

Open your own cute phone case shop and decorate cases the decoden way! 🎀

💗 DESIGN – Peel the film, tape the edges, then pipe swirly cream borders and fills. Blend colours as you pipe, add glitter, press in charms, and cure it under the UV lamp!

🍦 ROLL RARE CREAMS – Use the Cream Machine to win rare, epic and legendary creams. The rarer the cream, the more your case is worth!

🛍️ RUN YOUR SHOP – Put cases on display, ring up customers, finish custom orders and special deliveries, and hire a cashier and an apprentice to help.

🌸 DECORATE – Upgrade your boutique with display cabinets, plants, fairy lights and more.

📸 GO VIRAL – Take a photo at your photo booth and post it to the worldwide Feed. Like other players’ cases and save the ones you love!

🏆 COMPETE – Enter design contests, vote for your favourites and climb the leaderboards.

👍 Like & ⭐ Favourite for updates!
